title: Large selectBytes release coverage
impact: Adds a named `Large payload (~650KB)` `resqlite selectBytes()` row to the release JSON-bytes suite and curates it as `selectBytes() large bytes`, giving exp 174's native-view transfer path a release-history guard above the old 256 KB sacrifice threshold. Single-repeat release run measured 0.323 ms wall / 0.000 ms main for the new row.
